name: bld3_sqrt_two_rec_viete_prod_le
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ) : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2 ≤ 2 / Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi / (3 * 4 ^ (n + 1))
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ), ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2 ≤ 2 / Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi / (3 * 4 ^ (n + 1))
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_sqrt_two_rec_viete_prod and Mathlib2.bld2_sqrt_two_rec_viete_prod_gt: by the finite Viète product the product equals 1/(2^n sin x) with x = π/2^(n+1); sin x ≥ x - x^3/6 and 1/(1-t) ≤ 1 + 2t for t = x^2/6 ≤ 1/2 give the explicit O(4^-n) upper bound matching the library lower bound 2/π.
